# Lumeria's internal Starter copy

Copyright 2026 Ambryn for original Lumeria/Starter contributions.

The maintainer confirmed original authorship of those contributions on 2026-09-18.
They are covered by the repository's GPL-3.0-only license. This statement does not
relicense Electrobun, PixiJS, Skia, Dawn, Bun or copied third-party material.

Electrobun source modifications target v2.0.1, commit
`8d09d15db791f346e419efd452d6759750addb62`; retain the upstream MIT text in
`../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt` (electrobun-MIT section). Patches and modified SDK projections
are identified in `patches/` and `tools/patch-electrobun.mjs`.

`starter-manifest.json` describes the historical 0.3.4 import, including files that
may have since been removed. Current binary dependencies are content-locked by
`native-toolchain.lock.json`. Local changes are tracked with Lumeria's Git history,
not represented as an unchanged upstream Starter release.

Third-party copyright and license texts are retained in
`../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt`. The internal API is not a separately released stable public SDK.
